mapper.update: UPDATE users SET password = #{password}, refresh_token = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT u.*, COALESCE(s.department_id, p.department_id) AS department_id, d.name AS department_name FROM users u LEFT JOIN students s ON u.id = s.user_id AND u.role = 'STUDENT' LEFT JOIN professors p ON u.id = p.user_id AND u.role = 'PROFESSOR' LEFT JOIN departments d ON COALESCE(s.department_id, p.department_id) = d.id WHERE u.login_id = #{loginId} AND u.deleted_at IS NULL
